case.title: Analytics events carry no work order details, names or amounts
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser (private window) · Google Analytics DebugView access · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Analytics access: you can open Google Analytics for the property the QA build reports to, at Admin > DebugView. The QA build runs analytics in debug mode, so each event appears in DebugView within a few seconds under your user. If you cannot open DebugView, the event checks in this case cannot be done by hand: write "not checked by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see on the Work Orders page.
  • Event names to look for in DebugView: work_orders_display_view (a display was shown), work_orders_field_load and work_orders_density_load (the fields and density you have, once per display per session), work_orders_field_toggle and work_orders_density_change (a saved change).
  • Technician (example): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co" (kept as named: the expected results check that "Bravo Co" and the search text "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo" never appear in an event), with one contact and one asset.
  • Work order [WO-1] for "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co": Approved, with a lead technician and a total price.

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Top menu Customers > New Customer, Name "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co" > Save (skip if it already exists). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Record the customer as [Cust-1].
  3. Create a work order with one line: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in New Work Order pick Customer [Cust-1] and its Asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line, turn Line Approved on (this makes the work order Approved) > Save & Add Line for the next line or Save & Close. Record the number shown as [WO-1]. Pick any ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"); then pick Lead Technician "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha".
  4. Start a fresh analytics session: close every browser window, open a new private window and sign in.
  5. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All > search "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo" shows [WO-1], Approved, with a lead technician and a dollar amount in the Total price column (Column Selection > Total price). Google Analytics > Admin > DebugView shows your device. If the total is zero, the dollar-amount part of the check cannot be made: give the work order a priced line first.
case.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu. In Search type "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo" and wait for the list to update. The address bar now ends with ?search=ZZAUTOTEST+Bravo.
  2. Change the search to "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co" (add " Co" at the end) and wait for the list to update.
  3. Click Tech View, then Board View.
  4. Open Column Selection and turn VIN/Serial on. Then click Tech View and change the density.
  5. In DebugView, open every event from this session, not only the Work Orders ones (also page_view), and read every parameter, including page_location (the page address) and page_referrer (the address before it). Without DebugView: press F12, open the Network tab, type collect in its filter box, click each request and read en (the event name), dl (the page address) and dr (the address before it).
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every parameter holds only a field or setting name and its value (for example board_view, total_price, on, compact, default).
  • No event contains a customer name (Bravo Co), a technician name, a work order number, a VIN, the search text "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo" or a dollar amount.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S12-R5, read 8 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names.

Spacing (density) steps: PRD “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, Confluence 845185030, version 73 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 — S3-R11: “Board View shows no Density control in this release (SV-11580).” S6-R1: “Offer Compact, Regular, and Comfortable density in Tech View. Board View has no Density control in this release (S3-R11).” QA lead, 22 Oct 2026: the density step is done in Tech View.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R5: “Analytics may contain predefined field keys and setting values, but no displayed record values, names, identifiers, search text, or dollar amounts.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.

changes.old_value:

  2. Inspect the event parameters.

  4. Confirm the existing analytics identity is reused and no new customer identifier is added.
